description: This file contains unit tests for the AgentOps component within the litellm integrations. It tests configuration loading, authentication token fetching, and initialization behavior of the AgentOps class, using pytest framework with mocking and fixtures.

methods.name: mock_auth_response()
methods.description: Fixture that provides a mock authentication response containing token and project_id.

methods.name: agentops_config()
methods.description: Fixture that creates an AgentOpsConfig object with predefined configuration parameters.

methods.name: test_agentops_config_from_env()
methods.description: Test that AgentOpsConfig correctly reads configuration from environment variables.

methods.name: test_agentops_config_defaults()
methods.description: Test that AgentOpsConfig uses default values when no environment variables are set.

methods.name: test_fetch_auth_token_success(mock_fetch_auth_token, mock_auth_response)
methods.description: Test the successful fetching of an auth token and correct assignment of project_id.

methods.name: test_fetch_auth_token_failure(mock_fetch_auth_token)
methods.description: Test handling of failure when fetching an auth token.

methods.name: test_agentops_initialization( mock_fetch_auth_token, agentops_config, mock_auth_response )
methods.description: Test proper initialization of AgentOps with a valid configuration and successful token fetch.

methods.name: test_agentops_initialization_no_auth()
methods.description: Test initialization of AgentOps without authentication when API key is missing.
